label: H3 Live Action - Moving Connector
useWhen: two approved takes must join as one continuous action
body, object and camera velocity must cross the boundary
an editorial fade or frozen hold would hide a continuity defect
durationPolicy: 124 native frames at 24 fps (about 5.17 seconds), the local FL2VA minimum; use only when a direct kinetic cut cannot resolve a recoverable causal mismatch

handoffPolicy.connectorAllowedWhen: both sources pass independently and one causal irreversible action reconciles a recoverable mismatch
handoffPolicy.sourceRegenerationRequiredWhen: body, action phase, camera/geography, identity, weapon/effect ownership or persistent damage resets

required: approved start frame sampled inside moving source footage
approved end frame sampled inside moving destination footage
entry and exit body, object and camera velocity
kinetic handoff state for every fighter, camera, object/effect and environment
per-channel affinity decision with no source-regeneration requirement
one irreversible material change before the cut

forbidden: freeze frame or duplicated terminal frames
static first or last pose used as a moving boundary
first second used to rebuild pose, center actors or recover speed
smoke, fire, branch, whip-pan, darkness or shake used to hide a swap
RIFE or upscale before source approval

promptContract.language: English except original dialogue and visible text
promptContract.handoffRule: Continue inherited center-of-mass, support-foot, limb-phase, gaze, object/effect and camera state immediately; execute an irreversible action and leave the frame in motion for the destination take.
promptContract.cameraRule: Preserve shared geography while camera translation creates visible perspective and three-plane parallax.
